identity.name: Satyam Singh
bio: I'm an IT student passionate about the intersection of hardware and software — from IoT systems to full-stack web development. As an organizing member of Tech Connect, a 7-day IoT event, I coordinated sessions and announced the final day program.

Beyond academics, I bring 6 months of professional sales experience at MotoWorld Nepal, one of the country's leading bike gear showrooms, where I managed inventory, balance sheets, and social media — achieving 1.5 lakhs in single-day sales.
identity.heroHeadline: Building smart solutions for real-world problems.
identity.heroSub: IT Student · IoT Innovator · Sales & Tech Hybrid

projects.title: IoT Innovators Community Platform
projects.description: A community-driven platform for IoT enthusiasts in Nepal to share projects, collaborate on hardware builds, and organize events like Tech Connect. Features project showcases and event management.

projects.title: Tech Connect Event Portal
projects.description: The official portal for Tech Connect — a 7-day IoT event. Built to handle session scheduling, speaker profiles, live announcements, and participant registration for 200+ attendees.

projects.title: Smart Inventory Tracker
projects.description: A lightweight inventory management system inspired by my experience at MotoWorld Nepal. Tracks stock levels, generates balance sheets, and sends low-stock alerts via SMS.

projects.title: Nepal Bike Gear E-Commerce UI
projects.description: A modern e-commerce frontend prototype for bike gear showrooms. Features product filtering, cart management, and social media integration — reflecting real retail workflows from my sales experience.
